raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang has a dedicated directory (`layers/rotary_embedding`) designed to house unified, high-performance Rotary Positional Embedding implementations. 
 
Was observed that a complex-valued RoPE representation is highly efficient for the `neox_style=False` and `interleaved=True` configurations. However, implementing this complex multiplication logic directly within model-specific code leads to duplication and limits its reusability. 
 
Since this optimized complex RoPE path is generic, mathematically clean, and performant, it is logical to extract the implementation out of the model code and move it into the shared `layers/rotary_embedding/utils.py` utility module. This enables other models within SGLang using interleaved RoPE to easily inherit and reuse this optimization.


## Modifications

Were modified 4 key files to implement this refactoring and optimization:
 
### 1. `sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/rotary_embedding/utils.py`
- Added the `_apply_rotary_emb_complex` function:
  - **Inputs:** 
    - `x` of shape `[batch, num_tokens, num_heads, head_size]`.
    - `freqs` of shape `[num_tokens, 1, head_size // 2]`.
  - **Outputs:** Evaluated tensor of the same shape and dtype as `x`.
  - **Optimization Details:** It utilizes `view()` transformations to group activation dimensions and cast to `float32`. It then performs a single vectorized complex multiplication kernel. Calling `torch.view_as_real()` on the result natively lays out the real and imaginary elements sequentially in memory, producing the interleaved layout. This excludes the need for `torch.stack()` and `.contiguous()` allocations.
 
### 2. `sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/rotary_embedding/__init__.py`
- Registered the new `_apply_rotary_emb_complex` utility in the package exports: imported the function from `.utils.py` and added it to the `__all__` list to expose it cleanly to the rest of the codebase.
 
### 3. `sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/models/dits/mova_video_dit.py` and `mova_audio_dit.py`
Cleaned up the attention blocks and models:
  - Removed custom inline complex RoPE functions.
  - In `SelfAttention.forward`, reshape `q`, `k`, and `v` to `[B, S, H, D]` format using `view()` operations, and apply the `_apply_rotary_emb_complex` directly. This eliminates `rearrange` and `flatten` steps inside the attention loop.
 

## Accuracy Tests

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9239f012-ea90-496d-8823-01fe6d95584e


## Speed Tests and Profiling

### 1. SGLang Server Launch Command
```bash
sglang serve --model-path $(pwd)/mova_video_360p --pipeline-class-name MOVAPipeline --num-gpus 4 --ring-degree 1 --ulysses-degree 4 --performance-mode memory --dit-layerwise-offload --dit-offload-prefetch-size 0.1 --text-encoder-cpu-offload true --vae-cpu-offload true --enable-torch-compile --warmup-mode server --vae-tiling --vae-sp
```

### 2. Video Generation Request

```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:30000/v1/videos" -F "prompt=A curious raccoon" -F "input_reference=@/.../images/raccoon.png" -F "size=640x352"  -F "num_frames=49" -F "fps=24" -F "num_inference_steps=25" -F "guidance_scale=5.0" -o create_video.json
```

### 3. Offline Profiling Command
```bash
SGLANG_DIFFUSION_TORCH_PROFILER_DIR="/home/s60128115/profile_complex" sglang generate --model-path /home/s60128115/models/mova_video_360p --pipeline-class-name MOVAPipeline --prompt "A curious raccoon" --image-path /home/s60128115/images/raccoon.png --width 640 --height 352 --num-frames 49 --fps 24 --num-inference-steps 25 --guidance-scale 5.0 --profile --num-profiled-timesteps 10 --num-gpus 4 --ulysses-degree 4 --enable-torch-compile --warmup-mode request --dit-layerwise-offload --dit-offload-prefetch-size 0.1
```

### 4. Profiler Latency Results (Ascend NPU)
The table below compares the detailed execution times of the rope functions on NPU before and after modifications:
 
| Implementation | func_name | time(%) | total_time(us) | num_calls | Avg(us) | Min(us) | Max(us) |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Baseline** | rope_apply_head_dim | 100 | 	8983898.08 | 3080 | 2916.85 | 2378.38 | 7904.13 |
| **Modified** | _apply_rotary_emb_complex | 100 | 7139799.61 | 3080 | 2318.1168 | 2021.59 | 5624.96 |


## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).


## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

This pull request refactors the rotary positional embedding logic in the MOVA audio and video DiT models to use the unified `NDRotaryEmbedding` class and a new complex rotary embedding utility, replacing manual precomputation and sharding routines. Using `.reshape(b, s, -1)` instead of `.view(b, s, -1)` is safer here. The output of the attention block (`self.attn`) might be non-contiguous depending on the underlying attention backend or sequence parallelism communication, which would cause `.view()` to raise a runtime error.

```suggestion
        out = out.reshape(b, s, -1)
```

Thank you for the review!
1. I also tested the QwenImage model, and the `_apply_rotary_emb_complex` function allowed for improved performance, as seen in the table. This function is relevant for models using the RoPE parameter with `is_neox_style=False` on NPU, as this implementation is faster than the current fallback for this type of device and argument. I am currently preparing a PR with a class that unifies the call to RoPE, which will be used in subsequent PRs to analyze performance on other DIT models.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the rotary positional embedding logic in the MOVA audio and video DiT models to use the unified `NDRotaryEmbedding` class and a new complex rotary embedding utility, replacing manual precomputation and sharding routines. In the sequence parallelism pipeline, frequencies are now computed dynamically per rank based on local token offsets. The review feedback suggests improving robustness against non-contiguous tensors by calling `.contiguous()` before `torch.view_as_complex` in the new utility and using `.reshape` instead of `.view` on the attention output.
